name: Rod of Alertness: Detect Poison and Disease

system.description:
For the duration, you sense the location of poisons, poisonous or venomous creatures, and magical contagions within 30 feet of yourself. You sense the kind of poison, creature, or contagion in each case.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

definition.label: Rod of Alertness: Detect Poison and Disease

notes: not automated (utility): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
effect: "Detect Poison and Disease" (its own changes) not converted
concentration: nothing it sustains was converted
